annotations.title: Connect a domain I already own

description: Use this when the person already owns a domain at another provider and wants it to show their palimpalem website. Requires palimpalem sign-in. Returns exactly two DNS steps to make at their provider; with check=true it verifies them by DNS lookup and, when both are correct, asks palimpalem to activate the domain. It never writes into DNS zones by itself. For a domain managed by palimpalem it e-mails the owner a confirmation link instead, and the change is made only after the owner clicks it.

check.description: true to verify the two DNS steps after the person made them.

domain.description: The domain the person owns, e.g. panaderia-ruzafa.es.

web.description: Optional when the account has one website. The website: its name, its palimpalem address or its own domain.

name: conectar_dominio_existente
